---
title: "Original_averaged"
output: html_document
date: "2026-03-20"
---

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(motifmatchr)
library(BiocParallel)
library(chromVARmotifs)
library(chromVAR)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

motifs <- chromVARmotifs::encode_pwms
rse <- readRDS("sce.rds")
register(SerialParam())
rse <- addGCBias(rse, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
motif_ix <- matchMotifs(motifs, rse, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
set.seed(123)
bg <- getBackgroundPeaks(rse, niterations=100)
dev1 <- computeDeviations(object = rse, annotations = motif_ix, background_peaks=bg)
bg <- getBackgroundPeaks(rse, niterations=100)
dev2 <- computeDeviations(object = rse, annotations = motif_ix, background_peaks=bg)
dev <- SummarizedExperiment(list(deviations=(assay(dev1)+assay(dev2))/2,
                                 z=(assay(dev1,"z")+assay(dev2,"z"))/2),
                            colData=colData(dev1), rowData=rowData(dev1))
saveRDS(dev, "original_averaged.rds")

```
